fusions.name: Cliffside Gamble
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Drops onto the target for 8 damage, up to 1.6 times that at the full 6 tiles. Its damage rises 7% per tenth of your own blood already lost (max 35%).

fusions.name: Kicked Loose
fusions.desc: Sends a loose stone down onto the first enemy it meets for 14 damage and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Ledge Hold
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds and lifts you 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Unshaken Stance
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10% and your dodge chance rises by 5%.
